{{Quote|It's my Master's holocron. I promised him I would return it to the temple. Will you keep that promise for me?|Aubrie Wyn, to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="TBOJ" />}}
'''Master Sirrus's holocron''' was a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] owned by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sirrus]] and was in his possession during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
[[Sirrus]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Aubrie Wyn]], were participants in the [[Battle of Jabiim]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He entrusted the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] to Wyn, to return it to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] when she transferred there for special training under Master [[Mace Windu/Legends|Windu]]. After Sirrus was killed in the conflict, Wyn retained the holocron as she fought alongside orphaned Padawans of the [[Padawan Pack]] and the [[Jabiimi Loyalists]]. Knowing she would not survive a forthcoming battle to delay the [[Jabiimi Nationalists]], Wyn passed the holocron on to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] who was tasked with overseeing the evacuation of Republic forces from Jabiim. In this way, Wyn was able to keep her promise to her master.<ref name="TBOJ" />
